thread:
noah: Proposal: replace 'APAC' in public docs with 'Asia-Pacific' for clarity. Keep all programmatic identifiers (e.g., `ap-southeast-1`) unchanged.

noah: Affects: region matrix CSV, endpoints page, SDK quickstarts, and a couple of intro pages.

tess: For short table headers we can use 'Asia-Pacific (APAC)'. Will that work for translators? @i18n-bot

i18n-bot: yes. Recommend `Asia-Pacific (APAC)` in narrow columns; full pages should use the expanded form. Add `i18n: true` frontmatter so extraction picks changes.

ben: I'll grep snippets: `git grep -n "\bAPAC\b" docs | sed -n '1,200p'` and submit a docs-only PR.

legal: wording guidance: avoid implying single-country storage. Suggest: "Asia-Pacific  data may be stored in Singapore, Hong Kong, or Tokyo depending on routing and configuration."

noah: thanks. I'll add that exact sentence in residency callouts and put a CSV header comment: `# Human labels only; do not rely on for routing`.

tess: CI note: region-matrix CSV consumer checks only codes; I'll add a linter rule to assert comment exists and labels are not used as keys.

ben: opened PR 811 with the copy changes and CSV header. Preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.net/811

i18n-bot: PR flagged for translation extraction when merged.

noah: merging after legal thumbs up. Thanks all.
